programme.desc: Fillers Pluto TV

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: Verano de 1984. Thatcher gobierna y el Sindicato Nacional de Mineros (NUM) ha convocado una huelga. Durante la manifestación del Orgullo Gay en Londres, un grupo de lesbianas y gays se dedica a recaudar fondos para ayudar a las familias de los mineros.

programme.title: Las crónicas de la Grulla Blanca
programme.desc: Para vengar un asesinato, un monje debe cruzar la línea entre la verdadera justicia y la venganza a sangre fría.

programme.title: 12 Hours
programme.desc: Sigue un juego de supervivencia en un mundo virtual similar a Matrix contra varios desafíos, incluido un monstruo aterrador.

programme.title: Ace Bodyguard
programme.desc: Un guardaespaldas de élite "retirado", Zhang Han, une fuerzas con su ex compañero para salvar a su esposa secuestrada.

programme.title: Traición
programme.desc: Julio reúne a todos los miembros de su familia y les anuncia que padece una enfermedad mortal y que planea hacer algunos cambios en su empresa.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: James Hunt y Niki Lauda, dos pilotos de Fórmula 1 extremadamente hábiles, mantienen entre sí una intensa rivalidad. Sin embargo, es su enemistad lo que les lleva al límite.

programme.title: Dredd
programme.desc: Una prostituta convertida en traficante de drogas pretende apoderarse de la ciudad futurista de Mega City One. El Juez Dredd, miembro destacado de una fuerza policial de élite, es la última esperanza de la ciudad.

programme.title: Alienoid 1
programme.desc: Los guardianes extraterrestres usan huéspedes humanos como prisiones mientras un guardián rastrea a los fugitivos a través de los siglos, mezclando hechiceros taoístas de la dinastía Goryeo y tecnología futurista.

programme.title: Redada Mortal
programme.desc: Un hábil luchador es contratado para neutralizar al equipo de seguridad de una fábrica local y permitir que su empleador extorsione a su poderoso dueño.

programme.title: Batalla Espacial: La Armada Ataca
programme.desc: En 2420, después de que una raza de alienígenas y poderosos magos esclavizaran a gran parte de la humanidad, un grupo de rebeldes organiza un contraataque pilotando una flota de naves espaciales.

programme.title: White Space
programme.desc: La tripulación de una nave pesquera espacial se enfrenta a una criatura cósmica gigantesca y mortal mientras opera en un sector inexplorado del espacio.

programme.title: Querida Elisabeth
programme.desc: La vida de Sid Straw se desmorona a medida que trata de demostrar a sus amigos que entabló amistad con una celebridad mientras estaba en la universidad.

programme.title: Tras la pista del zorro
programme.desc: Aldo Vanucci (Peter Sellers), también conocido como "el Zorro", es un ingenioso y brillante ladrón. A lo largo de su agitada carrera, se ha hecho pasar por los más variados personajes, desde sacerdote a carabinero.

programme.title: Red Dog, una historia de lealtad
programme.desc: Basada en una historia real, la película cuenta cómo un perro recorre Australia creando vínculos con los habitantes de un pueblo minero, convirtiéndose en un símbolo de amistad y lealtad.

programme.title: La boda de Rosa
programme.desc: A punto de cumplir 45 años, Rosa se da cuenta de que siempre ha vivido su vida para servir a los demás, por lo que decide dejarlo todo atrás, tomar las riendas de su vida y cumplir su sueño de emprender su propio negocio.

programme.title: Primavera en Normandía
programme.desc: Un panadero observa cómo su vecina repite sin saberlo la historia de Madame Bovary.

programme.title: Tipos Legales
programme.desc: Val (Al Pacino) sale de la cárcel tras cumplir 28 años de condena. Doc (Christopher Walken), su mejor amigo, le espera a la salida para ir a ver a Hirsch (Alan Arkin), otro viejo colega.

programme.title: Compassionate Sex
programme.desc: En una desolada aldea, Dolores, una mujer bondadosa, madura, gordita y cariñosa cincuentona, es abandonada por su marido, hastiado de su excesiva generosidad.

programme.title: Drop Off
programme.desc: ¿Qué harías si te encontraras 1 millón de dólares? Únete a estos tres niños en la aventura de su vida. Viaja con ellos enfrentándose a retos morales, empujándolos a nuevos límites y encontrando respuestas que ellos nunca pensaron buscar.

programme.title: El club de los incomprendidos
programme.desc: Basada en la novela de Francisco de Paula. Un grupo de adolescentes castigados en el instituto descubre la amistad y el amor mientras comparten sus problemas. En elenco podemos ver a Ivana Baquero, Patrick Criado, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón o Raúl Arévalo.

programme.title: Love After Love
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su padre, dos hijos se enfrentan a las pruebas de sus propias vidas mientras ven a su madre explorar sus propios comienzos.

programme.title: Redada Mortal
programme.desc: Un hábil luchador es contratado para neutralizar al equipo de seguridad de una fábrica local y permitir que su empleador extorsione a su poderoso dueño.

programme.title: El tercer asesinato
programme.desc: El conocido abogado Shigemori defiende a Misumi, acusado de robo con homicidio, que ya cumplió pena de cárcel por otro asesinato hace treinta años.

programme.title: Cut Bank
programme.desc: Dwayne, un joven que fue atleta estrella y que ahora trabaja como mecánico, sueña con irse de la población de Cut Bank - la ciudad más fría de los EE.UU. - y mudarse a la gran ciudad, llevándose consigo a su novia Cassandra, que sueña con ser modelo.

programme.title: Ojos que te acechan
programme.desc: "El Ojo" es un agente especial del Servicio Británico, cuya misión es seguir a Joanna Eris, una mujer sospechosa de chantajear a un miembro del gobierno

programme.title: Mr. Jones
programme.desc: En los años 30, un periodista de investigación británico viaja a lo más profundo de la Unión Soviética para descubrir una conspiración internacional.

programme.title: Enemy Within
programme.desc: Una chica joven, que acaba de perder la vista por causa de una enfermedad degenerativa, lucha para expulsar de su casa a un convicto que se ha refugiado en la cabaña de su madre.

programme.title: 10.000 días
programme.desc: Hace 10.000 días, un cometa impactó con la Tierra en pleno océano Pacífico con la fuerza de incontables bombas nucleares, sumiendo al planeta en nieve y hielo.

programme.title: Cries In The Dark
programme.desc: La detective Carrie Macklin es informada de la inexplicable desaparición de su hermana, una mujer embarazada de nueve meses a quien acaba de visitar en su propia casa.

programme.title: Past Sins
programme.desc: Donna, una prestigiosa abogada, debe defender el caso de una mujer cuyo ADN ha sido encontrado en un asesinato cometido hace 20 años.

programme.title: En lo profundo del bosque
programme.desc: Tommaso, un niño de 4 años, desaparece durante un festival. Cinco años después, encontraron a un niño sin nombre y sin documentos. Coincidencias de ADN: él es Tommi, pero su madre se pregunta si ese niño no es realmente su hijo.

programme.title: Una Jornada Particular
programme.desc: Emocionante historia del romance sin futuro que en unas pocas horas, el día que se celebra un desfile por la llegada de Hitler a Italia, viven una sacrificada madre de familia y un locutor de radio que ha sido despedido por homosexual.

programme.title: El intruso
programme.desc: Tras un trágico accidente, un hombre se convierte en el objetivo de la peligrosa obsesión de otro testigo.

programme.title: Invencible
programme.desc: Zishe trabaja actuando como forzudo en Berlín. Mientras Hitler se va consolidando en el poder y en Berlín estalla el antisemitismo, Zishe llega a la conclusión de que ha sido elegido por Dios para advertir a su pueblo del peligro que avecina.

programme.title: Caza de brujas
programme.desc: En Hollywood a principios de los años cincuenta, un director es investigado por los comités McCarthy que van en busca de simpatizantes del comunismo.

programme.title: Romanzo Criminale
programme.desc: Tres jóvenes delincuentes, con la ayuda de una improvisada banda de malhechores, entre ellos El Negro, un extremista que se cree el último samurai, secuestran y asesinan brutalmente a un rico propietario.

programme.title: Los 28 De Panfilov
programme.desc: Un grupo de veintiocho soldados la 316ª División de Fusileros del Ejército Rojo bajo el mando del general Ivan Panfilov, detuvieron el avance hacia Moscú de una columna de cincuenta y cuatro tanques nazis de la 11ª División Panzer durante varias jornadas.

programme.title: Fría como un diamante
programme.desc: El inspector Klute investiga la desaparición de una gran cantidad de joyas para la empresa que las tenía aseguradas. Con la ayuda de la hija del mafioso que cometió el robo, Klute intenta recuperar el botín.

programme.title: Extra-Terrestres
programme.desc: Una familia, 100,000 pollos con una sentencia de muerte, una niña con un secreto que revelará los de su familia, y una estrella a 2,500 años luz que los hará entender que todos estamos, metafóricamente, fuera de este mundo.

programme.title: La segunda oportunidad
programme.desc: Una madre divorciada intenta hacer las paces con su disfuncional familia encontrando una segunda oportunidad en el amor.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: En Montreal, Jeffrey está a punto de cerrar otro negocio. Su esposa Marianne se siente frustrada por no poder ser madre. En la ciudad, vive Lucky, que está casado con Phyllis. Cuando Marianne contrata a Lucky, la vida de los 4 dará un giro.

programme.title: Señor y Señora Adelman
programme.desc: Contada mediante flashbacks desde principios de los 70 hasta la actualidad, el romance turbulento de una pareja empieza cuando Victor, un escritor angustiado, conoce a Sarah, una estudiante de doctorado brillante que se enamora de él perdidamente.

programme.title: La segunda oportunidad
programme.desc: Una madre divorciada intenta hacer las paces con su disfuncional familia encontrando una segunda oportunidad en el amor.

programme.title: Two Lovers
programme.desc: Leonard (Joaquin Phoenix) empieza a salir con Sandra (Vinessa Shaw), una joven encantadora con la que el matrimonio parece cercano. Pero aparece en su vida una nueva vecina, Michelle (Gwyneth Paltrow), lo que no hace sino empezar a complicar su vida.

programme.title: 4 Wedding Planners
programme.desc: Miriam, una mujer que adora a su familia y tiene una agencia de organización de bodas, ayudará a su hija mayor a recuperarse tras una ruptura bastante difícil.

programme.title: El permiso
programme.desc: Cuando a una reclusa se le concede un fin de semana fuera de prisión para ver a su madre moribunda, un oficial de corrección novato lucha por mantenerla bajo control.

programme.title: Breve encuentro
programme.desc: Adaptación televisiva de la obra de Noël Coward. Un hombre y una mujer no pueden evitar enamorarse.

programme.title: La felicidad nunca viene sola
programme.desc: Un músico conoce a una mujer con una vida muy distinta y ambos se enamoran.

programme.title: Aprendiz de gigoló
programme.desc: Un hombre convence a su amigo para trabajar como gigoló, lo que provoca situaciones cómicas y complicadas.

programme.title: San Andreas mega seísmo
programme.desc: Los científicos descubren algo horrible: el "Gran Terremoto" será en dos días y hundirá California en el océano. Su única esperanza es romper un volcán que desplazará la energía del terremoto y construirá una nueva corteza en la superficie.

programme.title: Oceans Rising
programme.desc: Un científico construye un arca enorme después de que se ignoran sus advertencias de una inundación que destruirá la Tierra.

programme.title: Megashark Vs. Kolossus
programme.desc: En busca de una nueva fuente de energía, los rusos despiertan accidentalmente el Kolossus – un robot gigante de la Guerra Fría. Al mismo tiempo, aparece un nuevo Mega Shark, amenazando la seguridad mundial.

programme.title: Tentáculos de las Bermudas
programme.desc: Cuando el Air Force One cae sobre el Triángulo de las Bermudas, la Marina envía su mejor equipo de rescate. Pero mientras salvan el presidente, el equipo despierta a una criatura que amenaza a toda la costa este.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: Un hombre lucha para darle un futuro mejor a su familia en un mundo inhabitable debido a una enfermedad propagada por el régimen totalitario que gobierna el planeta y que, además, posee el control médico de dicha enfermedad.

programme.title: Víboras asesinas
programme.desc: Un grupo de científicos, en un intento de encontrar cura para el cáncer, manipula el ADN de una especie de víbora muy agresiva, haciéndola más letal y peligrosa.

programme.title: Titanic II
programme.desc: On the 100th anniversary of the original voyage, a modern luxury liner christened "Titanic II," follows the path of its namesake. But when a tsunami hurls an ice berg into the new ship's path, the passengers and crew must fight to avoid a similar fate.

programme.title: Jurassic Games
programme.desc: Cada año, diez condenados a muerte compiten por su libertad en Jurassic Games, un programa de televisión donde los concursantes deben sobrevivir a los dinosaurios y a las trampas de sus compañeros. El último superviviente recibe libertad, fama y fortuna.

programme.title: C.H.U.D.
programme.desc: Una extraña serie de desapariciones repentinas en las calles de la ciudad de Nueva York parece apuntar hacia algo desagradable que vive en las alcantarillas.

programme.title: Freaked. La disparatada parada de los monstruos
programme.desc: Ricky, contratado por una empresa para patrocinar un componente químico, descubre que la molécula es responsable de monstruosas deformidades.

programme.title: Hijos de Dune
programme.desc: Atrapado por el fanatismo religioso, el emperador Paul Atreides debe confiar en sus hijos gemelos para destruir el mito de Maud'Dib.

programme.title: Tres caras
programme.desc: Dirigida por Jafar Panahi (ganador de la Palma de Oro 2025). En esta película premiada en Cannes (2018). La conocida actriz Behnaz Jafari acude al auxilio de una chica de provincias cuya familia quiere impedirle que siga estudiando.

programme.title: En tránsito
programme.desc: Segunda Guerra Mundial. En Marsella, refugiados de toda Europa embarcan rumbo a América, huyendo de la ocupación nazi. Entre ellos, el joven alemán Georg, suplanta la identidad de un escritor para utilizar su visado, que le garantiza refugio en México.

programme.title: Sin amor
programme.desc: Una pareja en medio de un divorcio no tiene más remedio que unir sus fuerzas para encontrar a su hijo desaparecido.

programme.title: Un asunto real
programme.desc: Osamu y su hijo encuentran a una niña en la calle, aterida de frío. A pesar de sobrevivir con dificultades gracias a pequeños robos, la familia es feliz, hasta que un incidente imprevisto revela un secreto que pone a prueba los lazos que les unen.

programme.title: La casa junto al mar
programme.desc: En una pequeña cala cerca de Marsella, Angèle, Joseph y Armand vuelven a la casa que construyó su padre. Angèle es actriz y vive en París. Joseph está enamorado de una chica mucho más joven que él.

programme.title: Gracias a Dios
programme.desc: Alexandre vive en Lyon con su esposa e hijos. Por casualidad, se entera de que el sacerdote que abusó de él cuando era un boy scout sigue trabajando con niños. Se lanza a un combate al que se unen otras víctimas del sacerdote…

programme.title: Corazón Silencioso
programme.desc: Tres generaciones de una familia se reúnen un fin de semana. Las hermanas, Sanne y Heidi, han aceptado que su madre, enferma terminal, quiera poner fin a su vida antes de que su estado empeore.

programme.title: El Taller de escritura
programme.desc: Antoine ha aceptado formar parte de un taller de escritura donde unos jóvenes, como parte de un programa de integración social, deben escribir una novela con la ayuda de Olivia, una conocida escritora.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Tras un divorcio difícil, Lucas, de cuarenta años, ha conocido a otra mujer, tiene un nuevo trabajo y se dispone a reconstruir la relación con Marcus, su hijo adolescente. Pero algo va mal. Un detalle. Un comentario inocente. Una mentira fortuita.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 22, Episodio 2
programme.desc: Jeremy, Richard y James se embarcan en un gran viaje por carretera a través del territorio del norte de Australia. Clarkson escoje un BMW M6 Gran Coupe, Hammond, un Bentley Continental GT V8 y May, un Nissan GT-R.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 22, Episodio 3
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond y James May relizan una valiosa encuesta de consumidores en su intento de mejorar y reforzar la ambulancia.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 22, Episodio 4
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson prueba el nuevo BMW M4 4n la pista antes de cambiar a otro BMW, el space-age, potente híbrido i8, en un revelador viaje por la A1 a Whitby.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 22, Episodio 5
programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson y James May encuentran proyectiles de artillería, corsés y coches con puerta trasera clásicos, en su nostálgico vistazo a una de las más interesantes y variadas compañías: Peugeot.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 22, Episodio 6
programme.desc: Richard Hammond cae en los restos remotos y helados de Canadá para probar un reloj con una baliza de emergencia incorporada. La señal de peligro se envía directamente a Jeremy Clarkson y a James May, que están alejados muchas millas.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 22, Episodio 7
programme.desc: James May se aleja mucho de su zona de confort cuando viaja en un coche con puerta trasera, muy rápido, muy tuneado y de 600 caballos, y lo tiran a la cueva de los leones en una carrera mundial de Rallycross.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 23, Episodio 1
programme.desc: Chris Evans lleva un Dodge Viper ACR al hogar de Top Gun en Nevada, para luchar con Sabne Schmitz en un Chevrolet Corvette Z06. Matt LeBlanc disfruta del Marruecos más salvaje en el mejor todo terreno de Somerset, el Ariel Nomad.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 23, Episodio 2
programme.desc: Matt, Chris y Eddie Jordan llevan a las estrellas de la música Sharleen Spiteri, Seasick Steve y Tinie Tempah a la prueba SUV en la Sudáfrica más salvaje. De nuevo en la pista, la superestrella de F1, Jenson Button, pasea a Chris en el McLaren 675LT.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 23, Episodio 3
programme.desc: Rory Reid prueba el nuevo Ford Focus RS, Chris Harris trata de domar al salvaje F12 TDF de Ferrari y Matt LeBlanc hace una visita relámpago a Londres en el temible «Hoonicorn» de Ken Block.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 23, Episodio 4
programme.desc: Chris Evans, Matt LeBlanc y Sabine Schmitz compran coches baratos de segunda mano y ponen rumbo a Venecia. ¿El objetivo? Probar que el viaje en carretera puede ser más lujoso que coger un tren.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 23, Episodio 5
programme.desc: Chris Harris está con el nuevo BMW M2, Rory Reid sigue un viaje histórico contrarreloj, para llevar el Jaguar tipo-5 SVR a la muestra de coche de Ginebra.

programme.title: Top Gear: Temporada 23, Episodio 6

programme.title: Contact
programme.desc: In this Zemeckis-directed adaptation of the Carl Sagan novel, Dr. Ellie Arroway races to interpret a possible message originating from the Vega star system. Once first contact with an extraterrestrial intelligence is proven, Arroway contends with restrictive National Security Advisor Kitz and religious fanatics bent on containing the implications of such an event. An incredible message is found hidden in the signal, but will Arroway be the one to answer its call?

programme.title: Suspiria
programme.desc: Famed Italian horror director Dario Argento helmed this vividly shot, nightmarish tale of a young girl's search to uncover the sinister truth that lurks behind the walls of a renowned German dance academy.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: Although Mary (Parker Posey) has little income, she still finds ways to spend her nights at clubs. After being arrested for throwing an illegal rave, she asks her aunt Judy (Sasha von Scherler) for bail money. Judy then finds Mary a job at her library so that Mary can repay her. Initially, Mary finds the job as a clerk boring and stifling, and prefers to get to know a street food vendor (Omar Townsend) whom she likes. However, Mary must refocus her life once she loses her job and apartment.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: When Helen, a London ad executive, is fired from her job and rushes out to catch a train, two scenarios take place. In one, she gets on the train and comes home to find her boyfriend, Gerry, in bed with another woman. In the second, she misses the train and arrives after the woman has left. Following the first scenario, Helen dumps Gerry, finds a new man and gradually improves her life. Under the second scenario, she becomes suspicious of Gerry's fidelity and grows miserable.

programme.title: Upside Down
programme.desc: Though it is forbidden, a man devises a way to reunite with a long-lost love from the twin world that sits just above his own.

programme.title: Contact
programme.desc: In this Zemeckis-directed adaptation of the Carl Sagan novel, Dr. Ellie Arroway races to interpret a possible message originating from the Vega star system. Once first contact with an extraterrestrial intelligence is proven, Arroway contends with restrictive National Security Advisor Kitz and religious fanatics bent on containing the implications of such an event. An incredible message is found hidden in the signal, but will Arroway be the one to answer its call?

programme.title: Righteous Kill
programme.desc: Detectives Thomas Cowan (Robert De Niro) and David Fisk (Al Pacino), 30-year veterans of the NYPD, investigate the murder of a pimp. The crime resembles a case they solved many years earlier. As the body count rises, they realize they're dealing with a vigilante taking over when the police fail. The similarities between past and present crimes leads the detectives to wonder if they put the wrong man behind bars.

programme.title: Stand Up Guys
programme.desc: After serving 28 years in prison for accidentally killing the son of a crime boss, newly paroled gangster Val (Al Pacino) reunites with his former partners in crime, Doc (Christopher Walken) and Hirsch (Alan Arkin), for a night on the town. As the three men revisit old haunts, reflect on their glory days and try to make up for lost time, one wrestles with a terrible quandary: Doc has orders to kill Val, and time is running out for him to figure out a way out of his dilemma.

programme.title: Operation Fortune: Ruse de guerre
programme.desc: Elite spy Orson Fortune must track down and stop the sale of a deadly new weapons technology wielded by billionaire arms broker Greg Simmonds. Reluctantly teamed up with some of the world's best operatives, Fortune and his crew recruit Hollywood's biggest movie star, Danny Francesco, to help them on their globe-trotting mission to save the world.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Melody Gardot, Charles Staab, Sam Minaie & Mitchell Long
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time. From David Bowie and Iggy Pop to Pink Floyd and Chet Baker, countless stars recorded unforgettable music here until the studio closed in the 1980s. Three decades later, Château d'Hérouville has reopened its doors. This program follows American singer-songwriter Melody Gardot as she visits the legendary studio. After an accident in 2003 left her hypersensitive to light and sound, Gardot discovered the healing power of music. At Hérouville, she gives an interview and plays a breathtaking live set. Her performance opens with a beautiful version of ‘Baby I'm a Fool' and includes ‘If The Stars Were Mine' and ‘Les Étoiles,' before concluding with the Chet Baker hit ‘You Don't Know What Love Is.' Melody Gardot (piano, guitar, vocals) is accompanied by Charles Staab (drums), Sam Minaie (double bass), Mitchell Long (guitar), Sylvain Gontard (trumpet), Ludovic Beier (accordion), Artyom Manoukyan (cello), and Guillaume Latour, Alexandra Kondo, and Benjamin Ducasse (violin).

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr. combined his singing talent and infectious sense of humor as he covered songs from a variety of genres.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Art Blakey, Wayne Shorter, Freddie Hubbard & Curtis Fuller
programme.sub-title: Art Blakey & The Jazz Messengers - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right. The group performed Cedar Walton's arrangement of That Old Feeling (written by Sammy Fain), Wayne Shorter's arrangement of I Didn't Know What Time It Was (written by Richard Rodgers), and Caravan (written by Juan Tizol and Duke Ellington).

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko
programme.sub-title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A Ravel's La Valse (arr. for two pianos) Arensky's Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15 and Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance' from Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture' from Nikolai Kapustin's Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Daniel Harding & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.sub-title: Brahms Tragic Overture & Mahler Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival's 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms's Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan'. Brahms composed his concert overture during the summer of 1880. With its dark and tumultuous character, it could be regarded as the serious counterpart of his more joyful Academic Festival Overture, Op. 80. Mahler completed his first symphony eight years later, in 1888. Originally a five-movement piece, the composer discarded the second movement ‘Blumine' some years later, resulting in the final four-movement version we know today. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia, Konstantin Khvatynets & Boris Berezovsky
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia is joined by acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin. Conductor Konstantin Khvatynets directs this concert, filmed at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow. The programme includes George Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue and Rachmaninov's Rhapsody on a Theme by Paganini and is produced by the Moscow Philharmonic Society, which Saint Petersburg-born composer Dmitri Shostakovich himself once described as playing a significant role "in the development of musical life [in Russia]. It is a kind of university which is attended by millions of music lovers and thousands of musicians.” The Moscow Philharmonic Society was founded in 1922 by then-Commissar for Culture, Anatoly Lunacharsky, and has over the years come to be Russia's leading concert organizing institution.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2 String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135 and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra, Gianandrea Noseda, Roman Simovic & David Cohen
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804. The choice of the three solo instruments effectively makes this a concerto for piano trio, and it is the only concerto Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique (‘Episode in the Life of an Artist … in Five Sections') is a programmatic symphony written in 1830, telling the story of a gifted artist who, in the depths of hopelessness and despair because of his unrequited love for a woman, has poisoned himself with opium. This concert was recorded at LSO St. Luke's in London, UK, on November 20, 2022.

programme.title: The Who
programme.sub-title: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle. As the evening shadows lengthened across the festival site, The Who took to the stage and delivered an incendiary performance packed with hit singles and classic album tracks and the concert more than lived up to the fan's expectations and memories of 1970.

programme.title: Supertramp
programme.desc: Supertramp's “Breakfast In America” was the biggest selling album in the world in 1979. It spawned several hit singles and went on to win two Grammy Awards and sell in excess of 20 million copies. Following the album's release Supertramp embarked on a 10 month world tour which arrived in Paris at the end of November. This show from the Pavillon de Paris was both filmed and recorded and now for the first time the full length audio and the concert film are combined in one set. The concert features the different song-writing styles of Roger Hodgson and Rick Davies, who each composed the songs on which they sing lead vocals.

programme.title: Burning Lies

programme.title: Live Once , Die Twice
programme.desc: (2006) Thriller starring Kellie Martin. A widow discovers her husband faked his death - and had another wife. Now, both women team up to uncover the truth about their heinous hubby's betrayal.

programme.title: Island Of Shadows
programme.desc: (2020) Dark thriller with Anna Hopkins. While staying in a house that once belonged to her family, a true-crime author unravels a sinister truth lurking in the shadows. Family secrets can be deadly...

programme.title: The Wild Geese
programme.desc: (1978) A-list action adventure with Richard Burton, Roger Moore and Richard Harris. The heat is on for the Wild Geese as they parachute into a hostile African nation to rescue its imprisoned leader...

programme.title: The Last Legion
programme.desc: As the Roman empire collapses, young Romulus Augustus must leave the city and set out for a dangerous journey to Britain to locate his last legion of supporters.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

programme.title: Peacock
programme.desc: John Skillpa, a quiet bank clerk living in tiny Peacock, Nebraska, prefers to live an invisible life. This might have to do with John's secret: he has another personality no one knows about, a woman who each morning cooks him breakfast before he starts his day. Then, in a moment, everything changes.

programme.title: Wild Card
programme.desc: Nick Wild (Jason Statham) is a Las Vegas bodyguard with lethal professional skills and a personal gambling problem. When a friend is beaten by a sadistic thug, Nick strikes back, only to find out the thug is the son of a powerful mob boss.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.sub-title: Incident At Victoria Falls Part One
programme.desc: King Edward asks Sherlock Holmes to perform one more task before his retirement: to safeguard the Star of Africa on a trip to Cape Town. Soon the fabled jewel is stolen and several people end up being murdered.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.sub-title: Incident At Victoria Falls Part Two
programme.desc: King Edward asks Sherlock Holmes to perform one more task before his retirement: to safeguard the Star of Africa on a trip to Cape Town. Soon the fabled jewel is stolen and several people end up being murdered.

programme.title: Meet The Spartans
programme.desc: A spoof of 300 (2006) and many other movies, TV series/shows/commercials, video games and celebrities. King Leonidas of Sparta and his army of 12 go to war against Xerxes of Persia to fight to the death for Sparta's freedom.

programme.title: Harlequin
programme.desc: An enigmatic faith healer - who appears to possess genuine magical powers - and a political fixer vie for influence over a senator and his family.

programme.title: Legend
programme.desc: Two young people are entangled in the ongoing battle between good and evil.

programme.title: Of Mice and Men
programme.desc: John Malkovich, Gary Sinise and Sherilyn Fenn shine in this contemporary remake of the beloved classic about a nomadic farm worker who looks after his dimwitted, gentle-giant friend.

programme.title: Timeline
programme.desc: Based on the Michael Crichton novel. TIMELINE tells the story of a professor who inadvertently catapults himself back to 14th-century France, in the middle of the 100 Years War.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: Russell Crowe stars as Noah in the timeless story of courage, sacrifice, and hope. This visually stunning, action-adventure is hailed as "one of the most unforgettable Biblical epics ever put on film." *Richard Roeper, Chicago-Sun-Times

programme.title: Criminal
programme.desc: The memories and skills of a deceased CIA agent are implanted into a dangerous convict.

programme.title: The Next Three Days
programme.desc: A family man finds his world turned upside down when his wife is convicted of murdering her boss.

programme.title: Empire State
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Liam Hemsworth. A security guard is convinced by his reckless best friend to rob the company he works for, resulting in a violent criminal gang and a tough detective on their trail...can they escape prison, or a worse fate?

programme.title: The Way of the Gun
programme.desc: Two criminals get more than they bargained for after kidnapping the surrogate mom of a powerful and shady man.

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: All Roads Lead To Rome
programme.desc: A timeless and moving romantic comedy. Uptight mother Maggie (Sarah Jessica Parker: Sex and the City) and her former Italian lover, Luca, go on a road trip across scenic Italy pursuing Maggie's rebellious teenage daughter (Rosie Day: Outlander) who tries desperately to return to New York. An unmissable, feel-good rom-com with a stellar cast. Not to be missed!

programme.title: Jasper Jones
programme.desc: A riveting and moving coming of age story based on the best-selling novel. Charlie is startled when he is woken by local mixed-race outcast Jasper, who leads him deep into the forest to show them something that will change his life forever. A moving drama starring Toni Collette (Hereditary), Hugo Weaving (The Matrix), Levi Miller (Pan) and Angourie Rice (The Nice Guys).

programme.title: The Furnace
programme.desc: Set in the 1890s gold rush of Western Australia and starring David Wenham (300), Jay Ryan (IT: Chapter 2), Mahesh Jadu (The Witcher) and Baykali Ganambarr (The Nightingale). To escape a harsh existence, a young Afghan cameleer partners with a mysterious bushman on the run with two 400oz Crown-marked gold bars. Together they must outwit a zealous police sergeant in a race to reach a secret furnace.

programme.title: Wakefield
programme.desc: Bryan Cranston (Breaking Bad) delivers a tour-de-force performance as a successful lawyer and family man Howard Wakefield, whose nervous breakdown causes him to disappear from his own life. Featuring supporting stars, Jennifer Garner (Dallas Buyer's Club), Beverley D'Angelo (Entourage) and Jason O'Mara (The Good Wife), this is a hilarious look into the ultimate midlife crisis!

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: Ex-felon, Eugene Brown, establishes a Chess Club for inner city teenagers in Washington, D.C.

programme.title: Loving Vincent
programme.desc: Vincent Willem van Gogh is undoubtedly one of the most famous and influential figures in the history of Western art. Yet during his lifetime Vincent struggled with poverty and depression, dying at only 37 years old.

programme.title: Where hands touch
programme.desc: In 1944, a 15-year-old girl, daughter of a white German mother and a black African father, meets a member of the Hitler Youth. They become bound by the realization of the horrors being committed around them.

programme.title: When We Get There
programme.desc: Two brothers set out on a 2,000-mile road trip to find their father, confronting uncertain futures, fragile relationships and the meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: Jingle Around the Clock
programme.desc: (2018) Holly-jolly rom-com starring Brooke Nevin. An ad exec's Christmas dreams take a turn when she's forced to team up with her rival on a career-altering project.

programme.title: A Merry Christmas Match
programme.desc: (2019) Charming Christmas romance with Ashley Newbrough. After years of working in her mother's small-town antique shop, a woman wonders if she needs something new after meeting a handsome stranger.

programme.title: Welcome To Christmas
programme.desc: (2018) Festive romance with Eric Mabius. Developer Madison visits Christmas, Colorado, for a ski resort development plan but finds community and holiday magic. Will progress threaten the town's charm?

programme.title: The Christmas Pageant
programme.desc: (2011) Festive romance starring Melissa Gilbert. A temperamental director is forced to direct a Christmas pageant. She finds herself swept up by the magic of Christmas, and an ex-lover.

Despite attempts, by her best friend, to get her to settle down and pursue her passion of fashion, Senna continues down a path of irresponsible behaviour, lost jobs, and casual hook-ups with younger men

programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: Blind
programme.desc: Bestselling novelist, Bill Oakland loses his wife and his sight in a vicious car crash. Five years later Socialite Suzanne Dutchman is forced to read to Bill in an intimate room three times a week as a plea bargain for being associated with her husband's insider trading.

programme.title: Frankie and Johnny
programme.desc: Join Elvis Presley and Donna Douglas for a riverboat ride of rollicking musical entertainment in this charming and sassy comic hit about a gambler and his lady love.

programme.title: Dognapped: Hound for the Holidays
programme.desc: An assistant of an influencer and a charming vet bond to find a missy puppy before Christmas.

programme.title: At Sachem Farm
programme.desc: Ross plans to sell his family's wine collection to finance a mining interest, but standing in his way is Uncle Cullen, who has different plans for the family estate.

programme.title: Christmas in Wonderland
programme.desc: Starring Patrick Swayze and Chris Kattan. Three children and their father move from California to Canada. When they go shopping at the mall, they find counterfeit cash, inadvertently help catch crooks, and make a discovery about Santa.

programme.title: Lights, Camera, Romance
programme.desc: Actress Emma Hutton is determined to help find her friend Hope a perfect match but in doing so, she accidentally tramples on several hearts. When Emma realizes she herself has always loved her good friend Gray, Emma learns love works best when she doesn't meddle with it. A charming romance inspired by Jane Austen's "Emma."

programme.title: The Shunning
programme.desc: All her life Katie Lapp has longed for the forbidden things, but will her dreams come at a price too dear to pay? Why would Katie's mother, a plain and simple Amish-woman who embraces the old ways, hide a beautiful satin baby dress in the attic? The staggering answers come on the eve of Katie's wedding to widower, Bishop John Beiler, with the arrival of a beautiful “Englisher” woman who has been searching for her, throwing Katie's life – present and future – into confusion.

programme.title: The Confession
programme.desc: All her life, Katie Lapp (Katie LeClerc) has known no other world than that of the Amish family who raised her. But upon discovering that she was actually adopted from out of the "English" world, her quest for answers to her identity resulted in her being shunned by her people. Now in "The Confession," the thrilling sequel to "The Shunning," Katie is on an even greater quest--to be reunited before it is too late with her long-lost birth mother, Laura Mayfield (Sherry Stringfield), who is dying of cancer. Only the challenges of being Amish in an English world stand in her way... along with one man who has other plans for her biological mother's legacy.

programme.title: Love, Lost & Found
programme.desc: Claire gets a surprise proposal on a mountain hike with her boyfriend Joey but when they get separated, a rancher turns Claire's head and a park ranger makes Joey see they're made for each other.

programme.desc: A convenience store worker plays dead to escape her abductor.

When more lies backfire, Katherine's kids become involved, and everyone heads off to Hawaii for a ridiculous, out-of-control weekend that tests the limits of how far we'll go for love.

programme.desc: Shanda is charged with the murder of the banker, Burton and to save her from being lynched, the sheriff sends her off to Phoenix. During the trip the two deputies to whom she's been entrusted rape and leave her in the desert, certain that she's dead. The girl is found by Black Talisman, an outlaw, who takes her to his hideout, nurses her back to health and after hearing her story, determines to avenge her and clear her name.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Melody Gardot, Charles Staab, Sam Minaie & Mitchell Long
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time. From David Bowie and Iggy Pop to Pink Floyd and Chet Baker, countless stars recorded unforgettable music here until the studio closed in the 1980s. Three decades later, Château d'Hérouville has reopened its doors. This program follows American singer-songwriter Melody Gardot as she visits the legendary studio. After an accident in 2003 left her hypersensitive to light and sound, Gardot discovered the healing power of music. At Hérouville, she gives an interview and plays a breathtaking live set. Her performance opens with a beautiful version of ‘Baby I'm a Fool' and includes ‘If The Stars Were Mine' and ‘Les Étoiles,' before concluding with the Chet Baker hit ‘You Don't Know What Love Is.' Melody Gardot (piano, guitar, vocals) is accompanied by Charles Staab (drums), Sam Minaie (double bass), Mitchell Long (guitar), Sylvain Gontard (trumpet), Ludovic Beier (accordion), Artyom Manoukyan (cello), and Guillaume Latour, Alexandra Kondo, and Benjamin Ducasse (violin).

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr. combined his singing talent and infectious sense of humor as he covered songs from a variety of genres.

programme.title: Rahsaan Roland Kirk
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Art Blakey, Wayne Shorter, Freddie Hubbard & Curtis Fuller
programme.sub-title: Art Blakey & The Jazz Messengers - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right. The group performed Cedar Walton's arrangement of That Old Feeling (written by Sammy Fain), Wayne Shorter's arrangement of I Didn't Know What Time It Was (written by Richard Rodgers), and Caravan (written by Juan Tizol and Duke Ellington).

programme.title: Nikolay Lugansky & Vadim Rudenko
programme.sub-title: Piano Duets - Mozart, Ravel, Rachmaninoff a. o.
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart's Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A Ravel's La Valse (arr. for two pianos) Arensky's Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15 and Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance' from Rachmaninoff's Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture' from Nikolai Kapustin's Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Daniel Harding & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.sub-title: Brahms Tragic Overture & Mahler Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival's 2021 edition, maestro Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program featuring Johannes Brahms's Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81, and Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan'. Brahms composed his concert overture during the summer of 1880. With its dark and tumultuous character, it could be regarded as the serious counterpart of his more joyful Academic Festival Overture, Op. 80. Mahler completed his first symphony eight years later, in 1888. Originally a five-movement piece, the composer discarded the second movement ‘Blumine' some years later, resulting in the final four-movement version we know today. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia, Konstantin Khvatynets & Boris Berezovsky
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia is joined by acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin. Conductor Konstantin Khvatynets directs this concert, filmed at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow. The programme includes George Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue and Rachmaninov's Rhapsody on a Theme by Paganini and is produced by the Moscow Philharmonic Society, which Saint Petersburg-born composer Dmitri Shostakovich himself once described as playing a significant role "in the development of musical life [in Russia]. It is a kind of university which is attended by millions of music lovers and thousands of musicians.” The Moscow Philharmonic Society was founded in 1922 by then-Commissar for Culture, Anatoly Lunacharsky, and has over the years come to be Russia's leading concert organizing institution.

programme.title: Quatuor Ebène
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer's sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven's 650 pages of sheet music. Their efforts culminated in the performance of the composer's complete repertoire for string quartet, which covers three decades of Beethoven's musical creativity, during six impressive concerts at Philharmonie de Paris in the autumn of 2020. Quatuor Ébène explored every facet of Beethoven's string quartet repertoire: from the youthful Opus 18 string quartets to the Razumovsky, Harp, and Serioso quartets (Opus 59, 74, and 95) from his middle period, and finally, the depth of his late quartets (Opus 127 to 135). This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven's String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2 String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135 and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: London Symphony Orchestra, Gianandrea Noseda, Roman Simovic & David Cohen
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804. The choice of the three solo instruments effectively makes this a concerto for piano trio, and it is the only concerto Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. Berlioz's Symphonie Fantastique (‘Episode in the Life of an Artist … in Five Sections') is a programmatic symphony written in 1830, telling the story of a gifted artist who, in the depths of hopelessness and despair because of his unrequited love for a woman, has poisoned himself with opium. This concert was recorded at LSO St. Luke's in London, UK, on November 20, 2022.

programme.title: Jack White
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: The Who
programme.sub-title: Live At The Isle Of Wight Festival 2004
programme.desc: In 2004 The Who returned to the Isle Of Wight Festival for the first time since their legendary performance in 1970. After a long absence, the festival had been reborn in 2002 and continues to this day. Their UK concerts in 2004 were the first in their home country since the death of founder member John Entwistle. As the evening shadows lengthened across the festival site, The Who took to the stage and delivered an incendiary performance packed with hit singles and classic album tracks and the concert more than lived up to the fan's expectations and memories of 1970.

programme.title: Supertramp
programme.desc: Supertramp's “Breakfast In America” was the biggest selling album in the world in 1979. It spawned several hit singles and went on to win two Grammy Awards and sell in excess of 20 million copies. Following the album's release Supertramp embarked on a 10 month world tour which arrived in Paris at the end of November. This show from the Pavillon de Paris was both filmed and recorded and now for the first time the full length audio and the concert film are combined in one set. The concert features the different song-writing styles of Roger Hodgson and Rick Davies, who each composed the songs on which they sing lead vocals.

programme.title: Adiós, caperucita roja
programme.desc: Fanny se traslada a una casa en el bosque tras la separación de sus padres. Allí vive rodeada de fantasía y surrealismo, enfrentándose a un lobo que habla, un árbol con rostros humanos y la protección de su bisabuela vidente.

programme.title: Chico conoce chica
programme.desc: En un París bohemio y nocturno, Alex, de 22 años, quiere convertirse en cineasta. Lo que más le fascinan son las primeras veces de algo pero su novia, Florence, acaba de dejarle por su mejor amigo, Thomas. Alex intenta estrangular a Thomas, pero se rinde y decide vagar por las calles. Esa noche, Mireille, una guapa joven que ha venido a París a salir en anuncios es abandonada por su novio. Alex contempla la separación. Y, por fin, estas dos almas atormentadas coinciden en una fiesta.

programme.title: La Chinoise
programme.desc: París, verano de 1967. Empapados del pensamiento de Mao Tse Tung y de literatura comunista, un grupo de estudiantes franceses se empieza a preguntar por su posición en el mundo y las posibilidades de cambiarlo, aunque eso signifique considerar el terrorismo como una posible vía.

programme.title: Afterglow
programme.desc: En Montreal, Jeffrey está a punto de cerrar otro negocio. Su esposa Marianne se siente frustrada por no poder ser madre. En la ciudad, vive Lucky, que está casado con Phyllis. Cuando Marianne contrata a Lucky, la vida de los 4 dará un giro.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: El velo pintado
programme.desc: Un médico británico lucha contra una epidemia de cólera en un pequeño pueblo chino, mientras está atrapado en un matrimonio sin amor con una mujer infiel.

programme.title: HANNIBAL: EL ORIGEN DEL MAL

programme.title: Parejas Criminales
programme.desc: La Policía de Singapur confía en Lim Chin Chin, Directora de Forense.

programme.title: Valkiria
